proof_of_existence: Server: nginx/1.10.3 (Ubuntu), X-Powered-By: PrestaShop in HTTP response headers...
remediation: Set server_tokens off in nginx.conf. Remove X-Powered-By header in PHP/PrestaShop config.

title: Conflicting SPF Records — Email Spoofing Risk
description: Multiple conflicting SPF TXT records found in DNS, causing SPF validation ambiguity.
risks: Email spoofing of playtunisie.com domain, phishing campaigns impersonating the domain
attack_vectors: Send spoofed emails from playtunisie.com — receiving MTAs may fail to validate SPF due to conflicting records
proof_of_existence: Multiple SPF TXT records found in DNS — conflicting SPF policies detected...
remediation: Consolidate to single SPF TXT record with all authorized mail servers. Add DMARC record.

title: No Sensitive Files Exposed — Positive Security Hygiene
description: Common sensitive files (.env, .git/, server-status, .htaccess, backup files) all return 404.
risks: No risk — positive finding indicating good file exposure hygiene
attack_vectors: None — files are properly protected or not present
proof_of_existence: .env=404, .git/HEAD=404, server-status=404, .htaccess=404, backup.zip=404...
remediation: Maintain current hygiene. Ensure no future deployments expose these files.

title: Web-Only Attack Surface — GCP CDN/WAF Blocks Automated Scanners
description: Target behind GCP CDN/firewall. nuclei and sqlmap time out at 180s. 193.203.239.21 (mail/FTP) confirmed down. Only web ports 80/443 accessible.
risks: Automated vulnerability scanning blocked — must use manual curl-based testing with appropriate delays
attack_vectors: Manual curl commands with 30-60s timeouts. Bypass CDN via origin IP discovery if possible.
proof_of_existence: nuclei and sqlmap both timed out at 180s against playtunisie.com. GCP CDN/firewall confirmed. 193.203.239.21 down...
remediation: Use manual curl-based testing. Consider CDN origin IP discovery for direct testing.
